summary.headline: Planetary Zones and Visibility
summary.text: Explanation of apogee and epicycle zones used in planetary almanacs, including special paired tables for the Moon because of its faster motion. Defines the appearance and disappearance of the five wandering planets and discusses factors affecting visibility, including solar rays, latitude, speed, ascensions and descensions of zodiacal signs, and atmospheric clarity.
